info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Position Update Management API
info.description: The Position Update Management API allows for the efficient modification of account positions within the banking framework. By utilizing this API, financial institutions can adjust position details based on changing market conditions or client requests. This service primarily benefits account managers and financial analysts who need to maintain accurate and up-to-date records of asset positions. Typical use cases include updating position values, reallocating assets, or changing investment strategies. Seamlessly integrate this API to ensure your organization remains agile in a dynamic financial environment.

patch.summary: Update Position Management for a Specific Account
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the position management details for a specific account identified by the resource ID. Use this operation to modify attributes such as position status, allocation, and other related parameters to ensure accurate account management.

requestBody.description: This operation updates the position management details for the specified resource. The request body must contain the details of the position that needs to be modified, following the schema defined for this operation.
